vocabulary: Gyro's positive effort levels only. none/minimal and thinking toggles are not exposed.

sources.openai: Codex signed-in model cache checked 2026-10-30: gpt-6.1-terra has a 500000 context window, low default effort, and low through ultra effort levels. Codex 0.163.0 signed-in catalog rechecked 2026-10-23: 500000 for gpt-6.1-sol, 272000 for the other models then available. A logged-out `codex debug models` prints the bundled 272000 stub for Sol. API maxima are separate. https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models
sources.anthropic: Claude Code 2.1.308 serves 1M by default for every picker model except Haiku 4.5 at 200K. The API table and OpenRouter's anthropic rows also serve 1M; those are separate connections. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows rechecked 2026-10-23.
sources.kimi: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html rechecked 2026-10-23. k3 and k3.1-pro are 262144 on Plus/Moderato and 1048576 on Pro/Allegretto. k3.1-pro-highspeed is Pro/Allegretto only at 1048576. The offline baseline is the lower ceiling; the runtime window wins. Efforts are low/high/max; K3.1 defaults to max. https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html
sources.xai: Grok Build CLI 1.0.67 models cache, fetched 2026-10-23 from https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/models. context_window is 256000 for grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, and grok-4.7-build-fast. 500000 is only the optional larger CLI window. This connection is not the public API.
sources.antigravity: Official Google Antigravity ACP 1.3.0 handshake; models discovered after authentication. No fixed context or effort advertised. https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/registry/blob/main/antigravity-acp/agent.json
sources.cursor: Configured externally; no fixed context or effort advertised.
sources.opencode: Configured externally; no fixed context or effort advertised.
sources.deepseek: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ rechecked 2026-10-23. Both models publish a 1M context length, stored as 1000000.
sources.mistral: https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/known-limitations rechecked 2026-10-23. 256k for Medium 3.5, Large 3, and Small 4; 128k for Codestral. mistral-large-latest still resolves to Large 3. Large 4 is a separate 1M id and is not in the picker.
sources.openrouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models fetched 2026-10-23. context_length and top_provider.context_length agree for every curated id. moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro is 1048576 with efforts max/high/low (none omitted) and default max. No separate highspeed model id.
